Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, compound_structures. Join: docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1121833'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
